dogecoin.text: Dogecoin exploded imo because: there was nothing to lose, the blockchain was a small download, most people were newbies and helped each other.

@ummjackson Part of dogecoin success in the beginning was that you could actually mine, download the full chain to have a full wallet, and it was worthless. First two are current "blockchain" pain points nobody likes to address, last one allowed for experimentation and friendlyness.
